runSummary.stalePolicy: Discovery age is not verification age. LIVE requires fresh full-detail/link evidence; list/search resurfacing cannot set verifiedAt.
runSummary.note: Diversified sweep covered Profesia, direct-company/public ATS, LinkedIn, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. Strongest fresh verified candidate is Pandora eCommerce Operations Assistant in Bratislava, confirmed on Pandora Careers with A2 English and graduate eligibility. LIVE jobs-data remains fail-closed because safe complete round-trip replacement is unavailable.

developmentChanges.title: Canonical cross-board promotion trigger
developmentChanges.reason: When a board result is mirrored by an active direct employer career page, automatically escalate the canonical employer detail for promotion review and store the board URL only as secondary evidence. This reduces duplicate review and improves source quality.

developmentChanges.title: Part-time income-stack score
developmentChanges.reason: Score 15-25h/week roles separately for compatibility with freelance/KomArena income, schedule predictability and effective hourly value, so strong part-time e-commerce/admin roles are not buried by full-time salary ranking.
